plastic.title: Plastic Honey Bottles Made for Your Product Line
plastic.text: Gracepack supplies PET honey bottles in bear, ribbed, oval, flat and inverted formats. We match each body with its neck finish and closure, prepare samples for filling and label trials, and provide the material reports available for the selected PET bottle and cap.

squeeze.title: Upright and Inverted Honey Squeeze Bottles
squeeze.text: Our squeeze-bottle range covers flip-top, pointed-nozzle and cap-down dispensing. Tell us your target honey weight and serving style; we will shortlist the bottle-and-cap combinations, provide samples for flow testing and quote the selected assembly with its packing.

glass.title: Glass Honey Jars with Lids and Export Packing
glass.text: Gracepack supplies mini, hexagonal and beehive-shaped glass honey jars with coordinated metal lids. We help size labels for the chosen jar, build protective dividers around the assembled pack and quote the glass, lids and export cartons together.

bear.title: Honey Bear Bottles for Branded Retail Packs
bear.text: Our honey bear range runs from mini sample bottles to 500 g-class retail formats. Each bear has its own face, grip, front label panel and neck finish, so we supply the selected body with its matched cap and an actual sample for artwork and dispensing trials.

inverted.title: Cap-Down Honey Bottles and Supporting Valve Caps
inverted.text: Our inverted bottles keep honey close to the outlet and stand on a wide closure. We match the body, supporting cap and optional silicone valve, then test the assembled sample for stability, flow, shut-off and leakage with your intended honey.

closures.title: Caps, Lids and Seals Matched to the Container
closures.text: Gracepack supplies flip-top caps, pointed nozzles, valve closures, PP screw caps, metal twist-off lids and aluminum caps. We identify the complete neck finish, build the liner or valve into the specification and provide an assembled bottle-or-jar sample before production.
links: Compare honey bottle caps and jar lids

hexagon.title: Hexagonal Honey Jars for Labels and Retail Lines
hexagon.text: Gracepack supplies hexagonal glass jars in individual sizes with flat label faces and matching metal lids. We size artwork within one facet, pair the lid with the selected finish and specify carton dividers around the actual jar shape.

mini.title: Mini Honey Jars for Samples and Hospitality Portions
mini.text: Our mini glass jars are supplied for commercial samples, hospitality portions and other small-fill programs. We help select the portion size, match the metal lid and confirm the carton quantity and protective packing for the selected jar.

plastic-jars.title: PET Honey Jars for Spoonable and Larger Packs
plastic-jars.text: Gracepack supplies wide-mouth, square, round, ribbed and handled PET jars. We match the jar opening to your filling and serving method, pair the complete neck finish with its PP, PE or aluminum cap and provide model-specific dimensions, MOQ and carton data.
